s: 那個病人不知道中了哪一種毒，不僅皮膚變黑，也昏迷好幾天了。
Nàge bìngrén bù zhīdào zhòng le nǎ yī zhǒng dú, bùjǐn pífū biàn hēi, yě hūnmí hǎo jǐ tiān le.
That patient doesn't know what kind of poison he was poisoned with; not only has his skin turned black, but he has also been in a coma for several days.

g: Above / Below with 以上 / 以下
Fractions: X 分之 Y (Y out of X)

s: 老師說得寫了生字、造了句，才可以下課。
Lǎoshī shuō de xiěle shēngzì, zàole jù, cái kěyǐ xiàkè.
The teacher said that only after writing the new vocabulary and making sentences can we leave class.
